column5: SceneObject slots 29-30 37 39 (frames, play, playIdle, stopAndRedraw(Dc), tick, stop, getTimerId, isRunning) and AnimationVtbl playOnce

Backdrop/GridBackdrop (two WinG bitmaps), TetrisBackdrop's create (the wall cells, BUGS.md E9), the occupancy grid and its queries
DIB loading and the row blitters (1000 is NOITE's byte-identical 32-bit segment)
TetrisGame: ctor/dtor, GameVtbl 01-06 (creators, init, onCreate), game_take_exit, the conditions
game_handle_message (GameVtbl 00, 3.5 KB: the engine default under the Tetris scene's handler) and the Portable pick-up/drop it calls
ObjectList, DrawList and message_box_printf (the shared box buffer g_messageText)

constructors (Piece/Player2D/Actor2D, TetrisPanel/ControlPanel/Animated3D/Animation) and frames
SceneObject slots 24-28 (occupy, vacate, attach, canStep, isStepBlocked) and reattach
the ControlPanel/TetrisPanel methods (ControlPanelVtbl 01-08), its draw and tick, the inventory icons
the Piece's game logic: spawn, new game, landing, line clear, PieceVtbl tryStep/moveTick, the score (cleared row, the %06d box)
the left and right move workers (switch kind/rotation over the board; BUGS.md E1)
the down move and rotation workers (BUGS.md E2)
SceneObject slots 08-0C getX/getY/getStep, 3B setPosition, 4E unk4E, 50/51 overlap tests, 52-5C defaults; next_object_id
SceneObject slots 13-1C (dirty rects, overlap, restore background, drawDirtyTo, draw, unk18, drawClip(To), erase, slot1F) and the DC hooks
Scene methods (SceneVtbl 01-04 06 08-0C), scene_create and the destructor
WaveMix (tetris2.wav)
SceneObject slots 00-07 0D-12 3A (Object3D getters/setters, unk11, drawBounds), the Object3DVtbl slots, the perspective math
TetrisScene: its handler (keys, gravity, landing, music, WM_DESTROY and 0x40a), create (MCI, WaveMix, the score), createScreen
SceneObject slots 1D-23 (redraw, hideAndInvalidate, blitToDc, invalidate, slot24, hide, show) and 4F redrawOverlapping
